nodes.description: msg.sender: caller identity used for ownership, token-contract gating and bet target
contractBalance: tracked token balance used for max profit calculation
owner: privileged address controlling admin functions
ZTHTKN: ZTHInterface used for external token transfers and approvals
maxProfit: cap on player payout, derived from contractBalance
gamePaused: emergency pause flag checked by gameIsActive modifier
playerRolls: mapping of player address to packed playerRoll struct
ZethrBankroll: bankroll address receiving deposits/approvals
minBet: minimum accepted bet size
maxProfitAsPercentOfHouse: percentage used to derive maxProfit
totalBets: counter of all bets placed
totalZTHWagered: cumulative tokens wagered
ZTHTKNADDR: trusted ZTH token contract address checked in tokenFallback
constructor: sets owner, token/bankroll addresses and initial config, approves MAX_INT
fallback: payable receive function for Zethr dividends
maxRandom: keccak256 over blockhash and entropy, weak on-chain randomness
random: modulo helper over maxRandom
calculateProfit: payout math with unchecked multiplications
_playerRollDice: stores a new roll and settles any previous roll
finishBet: public entry point that settles msg.sender's roll
_finishBet: computes result, updates balances and transfers payout
tokenFallback: ERC223 callback handling deposits from bankroll and player bets
setMaxProfit: recomputes maxProfit from contractBalance
ownerUpdateContractBalance: owner-only override of contractBalance
ownerSetMaxProfitAsPercentOfHouse: owner-only max profit percentage setter
ownerSetMinBet: owner-only minimum bet setter
ownerTransferZTH: owner-only external token transfer out of contract
ownerPauseGame: owner-only pause toggle
ownerSetBankroll: owner-only bankroll change with MAX_INT approval
ownerChangeOwner: owner-only ownership transfer
ownerkill: owner-only emergency transfer plus selfdestruct
dumpdivs: unauthenticated transfer of contract ETH to the bankroll
_zthToken: validates that a caller address is the ZTH token contract
ZTHTKN.transfer(target, profit + tokenValue) external token call inside _finishBet
selfdestruct(owner) destroys the contract and forwards balance
ZethrBankroll.transfer(address(this).balance) with no access control
Unchecked multiplication/division math in calculateProfit outside SafeMath
Randomness derived from blockhash and entropy, predictable/miner-influenceable
ZTHTKN.transfer(sendTo, amount) external token call in ownerTransferZTH
ZTHTKN.approve(...) grants unlimited token allowance to bankroll
ZTHTKN.transfer(owner, contractBalance) external token call in ownerkill
_rollUnder: player's chosen roll threshold
_tkn: TKN struct carrying sender and value for the bet
delete_it: flag deciding whether to clear the stored roll
target: player address whose roll is settled
_from: original sender of a token transfer
_value: amount of tokens transferred
_data: extra payload whose first byte selects the roll number
newContractBalance: owner supplied contract balance value
newMaxProfitAsPercent: new max profit percentage
newMinimumBet: new minimum bet value
sendTo: recipient of owner token transfer
amount: token amount transferred by owner
newStatus: new gamePaused value
newBankroll: replacement bankroll address
newOwner: replacement owner address
_tokenContract: address compared against ZTHTKNADDR
blockn: block number used as randomness seed
entropy: address mixed into the randomness seed
upper: modulus bound for random()
_initBet: bet size used in profit calculation
_roll: roll threshold used in profit calculation
_betSize: bet size checked by betIsValid modifier
_playerNumber: roll number checked by betIsValid modifier
zthtknaddr: initial ZTH token address passed to constructor
zthbankrolladdr: initial bankroll address passed to constructor
result: dice outcome derived from blockhash randomness
profit: payout amount sent to the winning player
rollUnder: cached roll threshold read from storage
roll: memory copy of the playerRoll struct
oldMaxProfit: previous maxProfit value emitted in event
chosenNumber: roll threshold decoded from _data[0]
_tkn: local TKN struct built from the incoming transfer
